mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect fair conditions and a mild 70 degrees around Badger Prairie County Park.

City offices and the recycling center will close November 26th and 27th for Thanksgiving, pushing Thursday trash pickup to Friday. Additionally, the city is planning a new Public Works facility to support local growth.
Local entertainment today includes live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, live music continues at Lake Lou-ee, followed by trivia events next week.

In police news, on Saturday, November 8th, officers responded to a single-vehicle crash on South Main Street where a vehicle hit a curb and light pole before catching fire; the driver was arrested for an O W I.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM featuring Crazy for Cookie Dough as today's Flavor of the Day, with OREO Cookie Overload coming up tomorrow.
